steps.say: **Assign to a class** sits on every teacher's row. Working from your staff list is how a new arrival gets their whole timetable in one sitting, rather than opening each class in turn.
It opens a list of every class in the school. Tick each one they should teach, then **Save** applies the ticks.
A class with nobody on it says so in that list, and the teacher you tick will lead it. Tick a class that already has a teacher and yours joins as a co-teacher instead.
steps.terminal: That's a teacher staffed — their timetable read and set from their own row. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
